bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears recently placed tight end Cole Kmet on injured reserve after he suffered a season-ending knee injury, a move that came alongside Montez Sweat's suspension being lifted by the Commissioner. The team is now preparing for a Monday Night Football matchup against the Seattle Seahawks in Week 8, a game complicated by Seattle's newly acquired offensive lineman Quenton Nelson, while persistent trade rumors continue to link Chicago with veteran pass rusher Khalil Mack.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions secured a Week 7 win over the Green Bay Packers, with quarterback Jared Goff throwing for 303 yards and wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown hauling in 153 receiving yards to fuel the victory.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: Wide receiver Matthew Golden remained a no-show at practice for a second straight day due to foot and shoulder injuries, raising doubts about his availability for Thursday night's Week 8 matchup against the Carolina Panthers. The Packers, coming off a tough 20-17 loss to Detroit that dropped them to 4-3, are also dealing with center Sean Rhyan's high-ankle sprain, which is expected to keep him out for at least a month.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings continued their historic start to the 2026 season, and following Week 7's results around the league, the Vikings are officially the NFL's last unbeaten team after Sunday's games, improving to 6-0 . With their perfect record, Minnesota moved up three spots to No.
